name: Assigns Group Membership
description: A group rule or an identity provider places users into a group automatically: a rule when its expression matches, an IdP at Just-In-Time provisioning or every sign-in. One relationship (automatic membership) over two mechanisms; the action property says which IdP mode applies.

action.description: RULE for a group rule; for an IdP, Okta's policy.provisioning.groups.action: ASSIGN (at JIT only), APPEND (add on every sign-in), SYNC (add and remove to match the assertion).
